mapper.select: SELECT rel.id, room.id AS roomId, room.room_name AS roomName, bed.id AS bedId, bed.bed_name AS bedName, rel.check_in_time AS checkInDate, rel.estimate_check_out_time AS estimateLeaveTime, rel.check_out_time AS realLeaveTime FROM bed_student_rel rel LEFT JOIN bed ON rel.bed_id = bed.id LEFT JOIN room ON bed.room_id = room.id WHERE rel.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY rel.check_in_time desc

SELECT rel.id, room.id AS roomId, room.room_name AS roomName, bed.id AS bedId, bed.bed_name AS bedName, rel.check_in_time AS checkInDate, rel.estimate_check_out_time AS estimateLeaveTime, rel.check_out_time AS realLeaveTime FROM bed_student_rel rel LEFT JOIN bed ON rel.bed_id = bed.id LEFT JOIN room ON bed.room_id = room.id WHERE rel.student_id = #{studentId} AND rel.check_out_time IS NULL LIMIT 1
